output: Scored this gorgeous butterfly print Y2K baby tee on Depop for only $18 and I’m obsessed. I'm leaning all the way into the nostalgic vibes today, pairing it with baggy dark-wash jeans and chunky sneakers. It’s giving effortless 2000s comfort, but I can't wait to toughen it up with combat boots and a distressed denim jacket next time.

Scored this cropped light wash denim jacket on Poshmark for just $42, and it’s about to be my entire personality. I'm already planning to live in it with baggy dark-wash jeans for a double denim moment, or layered over a black zip hoodie with khakis for the ultimate casual streetwear fit. It has that perfectly broken-in vintage look that instantly pulls any outfit together.

Scored these chunky white platforms on Poshmark for just $48 and I am obsessed! I'm already planning to live in them with baggy dark denim and a cropped zip hoodie for that ultimate Y2K streetwear vibe. They also look insanely good dressed down with wide-leg trousers and an oversized crewneck for easy, elevated neutrals.

Scored this Y2K butterfly print baby tee on Depop for just $18 and I am obsessed. It’s giving major nostalgic vibes, so I’m leaning into a casual Y2K street look with baggy dark-wash jeans and chunky sneakers. Can't wait to style it with wide-leg trousers and combat boots for an edgy contrast, too!

Scored these khaki low-rise cargo pants on Poshmark for just $27 and I’m so obsessed with the fit. They’re giving major off-duty Y2K streetwear vibes, especially paired with my zip hoodie and chunky sneakers. Can't wait to grunge them up with a big crewneck and combat boots next!
